subject: VCF file import error in Tassel_order correctly

messages.author: c10d0512ef945b07
messages.subject: VCF file import error in Tassel_order correctly
parts:
Hello,

I am using this code to convert my file:
gl7.VCF <- gl2vcf(gl7, plink_path = getwd(), outfile = "gl7_VCF", outpath = getwd(),
                  snp_pos = "0", snp_chr = "0", chr_format = "character",
                  pos_cM = "0", sex_code = "unknown", phen_value = "0",verbose = NULL)
I see the generated files in my working directory, however since ultimately I want to import them into TASSEL software, I get the attached error message. I don't have chromosome information for my species. 

Can you please suggest how I can use the 'SortgenotypeFilePlugin' to correctly order the input file?


The following are the loc.metrices
@other$loc.metrics: AlleleID, CloneID, ClusterTempIndex, AlleleSequence, ClusterConsensusSequence, ClusterSize, AlleleSeqDist, SNP, SnpPosition, CallRate, OneRatioRef, OneRatioSnp, FreqHomRef, FreqHomSnp, FreqHets, PICRef, PICSnp, AvgPIC, AvgCountRef, AvgCountSnp, RatioAvgCountRefAvgCountSnp, FreqHetsMinusFreqMinHom, AlleleCountsCorrelation, aggregateTagsTotal, DerivedCorrMinusSeedCorr, RepRef, RepSNP, PicRepRef, PicRepSNP, TotalPicRepRefTest, TotalPicRepSnpTest, RepAvg, clone, uid, rdepth, maf

You can try:
library(dartR)

t1 <- platypus.gl
t1$other$loc.metrics$pos <- 1:nLoc(t1)
t1$other$loc.metrics$chr <- rep("1",nLoc(t1))
gl7.VCF <- gl2vcf(t1, plink_path = getwd(), outfile = "gl7_VCF", outpath = getwd(),
                  snp_pos = "pos", snp_chr = "chr", chr_format = "character",
